name: Check_Availability
description: Check if a specific doctor is available at a given date and time. Must be called BEFORE booking any appointment. Requires doctor_id (from List_Doctors) and time in ISO 8601 format. The backend validates timezone (Africa/Cairo), working hours (08:00-17:00 Mon-Fri), future dates only, and 30-minute slot alignment.

query_params_schema.description: The numeric doctor ID (e.g. 1, 2, 3). Obtain this from the List_Doctors tool response.
Requested appointment date and time in ISO 8601 format (e.g. 2026-05-12T10:00:00). Must be a future weekday between 08:00-17:00 Africa/Cairo timezone. Minutes must be :00 or :30 only.
